prompt:
[SYSTEM INSTRUCTION: Image 1 is NECRO. KEEP HIM STRICTLY ON MODEL. Necro has his long pointed nose, red tattoos, and no eyebrows. DO NOT ALTER DESIGN.]

ART STYLE & AESTHETIC (CRITICAL): Authentic JUNJI ITO horror manga style. 
- MEDIUM: Pure black and white ink on paper. NO COLOR. 
- TECHNIQUE: Meticulous fine-line work, extreme cross-hatching, and dense ink stippling. 
- TEXTURE: Meticulously detailed skin textures, showing every pore, wrinkle, and tiny vein. The background is filled with unsettling, organic spiral patterns (Uzumaki style). NO 3D, NO digital gradients.

SCENE COMPOSITION (THE MACABRE TRANSFORMATION): A 16:9 claustrophobic close-up portrait of NECRO. 
- THE FACE: Necro is staring directly into the camera with wide, dilated, and soulless eyes. He has a terrifyingly wide, needle-toothed grin. His face is covered in fine, shaky ink lines that emphasize a state of extreme psychological distress.
- BODY HORROR: His neck and arms are beginning to distort. His neck is slightly elongated and twisted, with the skin showing realistic, disturbing tension. His limbs are beginning to coil into tight, muscular spirals. 
- BACKGROUND: A dark, oppressive void filled with Junji Ito's signature swirling, hypnotic cloud patterns and jagged black ink splatters.

LIGHTING & SHADOW: Extreme "Manga Noir" contrast. One side of his face is buried in deep, pitch-black ink shadows created by thousands of tiny hatching lines. The highlights are the raw white of the paper.

MOOD: Unsettling, macabre, and bone-chilling. The realization that Necro is no longer human, but a biological nightmare. Nível Deus de horror.
